subject: Custom SLA request - Pioneer Analytics
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@pioneer-analytics.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pioneer-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Custom SLA & latency commitment request

Priya —

Thanks again for the demo today. Pioneer is preparing a strategic integration that will put Redwood behind a customer-facing analytics feature for three of our flagship customers. Our legal and platform teams have asked for an explicit SLA: 99.99% monthly uptime and p95 latency at or under 50ms for text-generation endpoints (60k rqpm expected at peak across two regions).

I realize this is beyond the standard public SLA. We are prepared to discuss a committed spend/discount in exchange for guaranteed capacity and fallbacks. Can your team confirm feasibility and what exceptions (ops/engineering/product) would be required? We need a rough yes/no and high-level engineering constraints by EOD Friday so we can decide whether to include the commitment in the procurement RFx.

Attaching our draft SLA for reference (pioneer-sla-draft-v2.pdf).

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform
Pioneer Analytics

Looping you all in — Pioneer (large new prospect) just requested a 99.99% SLA + 50ms p95 for generation. They expect ~60k peak requests/minute across two regions.

Ask: can Product/Serving confirm if we can commit to that level with Dedicated capacity + reserved allocation, and what hard trade-offs are (cost uplift, required redundancy, fallback policy)? Also need legal/finance input on discount/credit structure if we accept.

- Product/Serving: quick ops feasibility note by EOD Friday (Laura/Sean)
- Sales: draft mutual action plan and proposed committed spend (Karthik)
- Finance/Legal: high-level acceptable discount bands for committed spend (I will loop in externally once internal alignment)

This is time-sensitive for their procurement window.

Thanks — Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custom SLA & latency commitment request

Priya / Karthik —

Quick feasibility note from Product/Serving and SRE perspective. TL;DR: 99.99% + 50ms p95 is extremely aggressive but potentially achievable with the following conditions and an explicit carveout:

1) Dedicated capacity: Pioneer must reserve a set of GPU pool shards in both us-west and us-east with hot standby cross-region failover. That removes noisy-neighbor variability. Estimated baseline: 48 A100-equivalent GPUs split across regions (detailed sizing attached in ops-impact-analysis.xlsx).

2) Network & routing: We need Pioneer to accept regional routing (their clients pinned to nearest region) and to allow our temporary burst fallback to a 99.95% tier during non-critical hours. Explicit fallback windows, and customer-visible notice requirements must be in contract.

3) Quantization & model variant: To hit 50ms p95 we recommend a slightly smaller model variant or Q4/INT8 quantized runtime; there will be marginal quality trade-offs for some prompt shapes. We can commit to a regression monitoring cadence and rollback policy.

4) Operational runbook: Additional on-call duties and a higher P1 SLA for our SREs for this account (we will require incident response credits if we step outside defined runbook).

5) Cost uplift & discount: Estimated +220% unit cost vs standard hosted. We should negotiate committed spend to offset (proposal in the Drive doc).

Attachments: ops-impact-analysis.xlsx (sizing + cost), added a redlined sample of acceptable fallback language in the drive link.

If Sales and Legal are comfortable with those constraints, Product is willing to approve a formal SLA carveout with the following gating items: documented committed spend (3–12 month term), signed incident runbook, and acceptance of fallback windows.

I can draft a short technical appendix for the contract if Legal wants it.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product (Serving & Reliability)
Redwood Inference
From: legal@pioneer-analytics.com <legal@pioneer-analytics.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pioneer-analytics.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custom SLA & latency commitment request

Priya / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Laura. A few clarifying points from Procurement & Legal before we proceed:

- Pioneer prefers firm uptime commitments without fallback for customer-facing periods (9a–9p PT). If fallback is mandatory, we need a clearly defined notification SLA and automatic crediting.
- We will review the ops-impact-analysis but need an estimate of the financial concession Pioneer should expect given the +220% cost uplift Laura flagged. Our procurement team will use that to determine the committed spend threshold.
- Please provide a copy of your proposed incident runbook and escalation matrix.

We can turn around a redline once we get those items; our timeline is also tight — need something executable in two weeks.

—Pioneer Legal
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pioneer-analytics.com; legal@pioneer-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custom SLA & latency commitment request

Team —

Decision: I approve granting a formal SLA exception for Pioneer subject to these binding conditions (we discussed with Execs this morning):

1) Signed committed spend for a minimum 6-month term at the Tier-2 committed rate (proposal in HubSpot: HS-2384972).
2) Pioneer accepts a documented fallback clause limited to non-peak windows (we will list customer-facing periods explicitly).
3) SRE runbook & escalation matrix to be delivered by Monday COB (Sean to author).
4) Legal to include automatic outage credit formula tied to measured p95 and monthly availability; Finance will pick final discount thresholds but they must cover the +220% cost uplift estimate.

Priya/Karthik — please proceed to draft the mutual action plan and contract appendix. I have uploaded a short technical appendix and the required operational conditions to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-pioneer-sla). Once Pioneer signs, we will provision the Dedicated pools and begin onboarding.

I'll join the exec review if there are any deviations.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product (Serving & Reliability)
